name: Acid Ladder
description: A diode ladder that opens as the audio gets loud.

name: Auto-Wah
description: A resonant band-pass that follows the playing.

name: Comb Shimmer
description: A comb tuned to 440 Hz and its multiples, swept slowly an octave either way.

name: Dark Warmth
description: A gentle ladder low-pass with a little drive.

name: Phaser Swirl
description: The phaser's notches swept round 1 kHz, fed back for a deeper swirl.

name: Screaming Highpass
description: A driven Sallen-Key high-pass on the edge.

name: Synced Wobble
description: A transistor ladder swept on eighth notes.

name: Talking Vowels
description: A formant filter on the vowel e, its formants raised by the playing.

name: Telephone
description: A narrow band of the mids, as through a phone.
